queue_wait.main_guest_thread_at_interrupt: inside 0x823A0310 while polling the predicate and queue state
queue_wait.other_guest_threads: Several XEX worker threads were blocked in ReXGlue-backed KeWaitForSingleObject waits.

interpretation.supported: The same runtime produced the no-GPU-plugin warnings and stopped in sub_823A4E48 waiting in sub_823B34A0. Exact-XEX disassembly now verifies that this is a guest ring/cursor polling loop which repeatedly calls predicate 0x823A0310; the observed unchanged head/tail and clear 0x02 bit match that path. This makes an unserviced Xenos ring/completion path the leading explanation, while plugin-enabled runtime confirmation is still needed.
interpretation.not_proven: This does not prove that loading the Xenos plugin will resolve the wait, or establish a PPC/P-code or host scheduler defect, or prove a retail draw/Vulkan present.
interpretation.next_owner: Process 2 owns loading and validating the Xenos GPU plugin. Repeat this probe after plugin setup before classifying the guest queue wait as a runtime defect.

user_visual_observation: The user confirmed that the game's loading screen appeared during a ReXGlue Xbox run, but the exact process/build hash was not recorded and the screen is no longer visible. This observation is not correlated to this controlled runtime binary.
